[editing, editing guide, editing tips, full time content creator, adobe premier mobile, editing apps]
You want to start your content creation journey but struggling to edit a simple video? Well, let me help you out. Today, I'll be editing a super fun vlog from my Vietnam trip. Step one is trimming and cutting clips. Go to the Premiere mobile app, upload all your footages, and start trimming the clip using the split option. Step two is adding transition. This app has a lot of transition features like this to spice up your video as this helps your audience watch the video till the end because this generation does not like watching boring videos. Step three is color adjustment or filters. You can choose different filters or adjust the lighting of each clip to match the vibe of your overall video. Step four is adding texts. You can easily add text and captions, they have so many font options. Step five is adding music, this app has a lot of sound effect options and copyright-free music to choose from. Lastly, I export all my videos at 4K 60fps to maintain high video quality. Honestly, this app is user-friendly and all these features are absolutely free. It has helped me a lot in my content creation journey. So, download the Adobe Premiere Pro mobile app on your iPhone and try it for yourself now.

instagram.author: outdoorbrooke
instagram.body:
Raise your hand if you’re sick of late hotel check-ins and painfully early check-outs 🙋‍♀️ #ad

When I’m planning a trip, I care about two things: cost and flexibility.

Because realistically… I don’t have thousands of dollars to throw at every trip, and I never know when weather, road conditions, delayed flights, or life in general are going to mess with my itinerary.

That’s why I use @RVshare instead of booking overpriced hotels.

I can travel on my own schedule, wake up in places with incredible views, and not stress about rushing to make a 4PM check-in or 10AM check-out.

You just pick your destination, choose an RV that fits your trip style and budget, and hit the road.

Travel should feel freeing, not like you’re constantly racing against someone else’s timeline. #RVshare #RVsharetrip #roadtrip #RVsharePartner
When I'm planning a trip, I care about costs and flexibility. Not being stuck to hotel check-in times. I want to stay somewhere with views, and actually enjoy them. That's why I use RVshare. All you do is search your destination, compare options and book something that fits your trip, and then you're set. To go wherever you want, whenever you want.
